body_lead: Loading... # Green Visakha urges AP government block Google's $15B AI plan By [NewsBytes Desk](https://www.newsbytesapp.com/author/newsbytes-desk/113) --- Green Visakha, an environmental group, is urging the Andhra Pradesh government to stop Google's massive $15 billion AI data center plans in Visakhapatnam and Anakapalli. Marking a year since the state signed a memorandum of understanding with Google, they rallied for more transparency and want a detailed public breakdown of all agreements.
